description.zh:
需要删除的SQL限流规则名称。支持输入多个规则名称进行批量删除，多个名称间用英文逗号（,）分隔。
> 您可以通过[DescribeSQLRateLimitingRules](~~212573~~)接口查看目标集群下所有SQL限流规则规则的详情，包括规则名称。
description.en:
The names of the SQL throttling rules to delete. To delete multiple rules in a batch, separate the rule names with commas (,).

> Call the [DescribeSQLRateLimitingRules](~~212573~~) operation to view the details of all SQL throttling rules for the target cluster, including their names.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun polardb delete-sql-rate-limiting-rules --db-cluster-id pc-00000000000000 --rule-name-list testrule --region cn-hangzhou
